note: Both sets capture the LIGHTING LEVELS graphic (3/5-10/30/50 FC with bulb counts and activities) and both repeat claims heavily. Set A uniquely extracts the wattage example (40W incandescent, 9W compact, 7W LED and the equal-light-output comparison), but it entirely omits the page's normative requirements. Set B uniquely and correctly captures the T24 high-efficacy requirement, the own-switch requirement with its room conditions, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement, keeping the stated conditions. Since the regulatory requirements are the core engineering content and B is somewhat less redundant, B is the better set, though it loses the bulb-wattage example.
